settings.note: Channels, buffer, analysis, keyboard and library settings follow with the next stages.
settings.audioNote: Switching takes effect immediately; loaded decks stay. With four or more channels the headphones are on 3/4.
stage.aria: Parallel waveforms of deck A and deck B
stage.empty: Deck {deck} empty – drag a track here
stage.peekHint: moves only the view of the playing decks, not playback; a stopped deck stays put · Shift + wheel
deck.dropHere: Drop here to load on deck {deck}
deck.overview: Overview deck {deck}: click jumps to position
deck.cue: Cue: stopped – hold to audition · playing – back to cue point and stop
lib.heading: Library
lib.hint: Double-click loads into an empty deck · Shift + ← / → or A / B loads deliberately · dragging works too
lib.title: Title
notice.nothingSelected: No track selected. Pick one with ↑ / ↓ in the list.
placeholder.library: The whole collection will live here: playlists, filters for BPM, key and energy, compatibility with the playing track and the analysis progress.
placeholder.prepare: A single track gets prepared here: check the beatgrid, set sections and cue points, correct key and tempo.
placeholder.automix: Deckwerk will plan a whole set from a playlist here, show it as an editable timeline and render it to an audio file.
ds.title: Design system
ds.lead: Guiding idea “test bench”: soot-black surfaces, waveforms in three metal layers, cold signal colours for the decks only, chamfered corners instead of rounding. Everything here comes from the tokens in src/design/tokens.css.
ds.keysNote: Twelve hues around the wheel as a bar on the left; the code is in text colour on a dark ground. Minor (A) darker bar, major (B) lighter bar and a notch.
ds.contrastOn: Right column: contrast against the panel surface {bg}.
ds.knobNote: Drag (vertical), wheel, Shift = fine, double-click = default. The outer notch marks the default, the dark segment at the left stop the kill zone.
ds.faderNote: Dragging is relative: clicking beside the cap never makes the value jump.
ds.meterNote: Slats from −36 to +6 dB, 30 dB/s fall, peak hold. Yellow from −9 dB, red from 0 dB; the block on top latches a clip.
ds.tipNote: Name, current value, shortcut. Appears after a short dwell and immediately while a control is dragged.
ds.waveformNote: Stacked away from the rail: copper (low), brass (mid), tin (high). The played part is dimmed; a killed band is hatched instead of filled. In the rail each beat mark fills its half; when the decks drift apart the offset turns yellow.
hdr.noDevice: No audio device – the engine runs silently
hdr.noDeviceHint: Connect an audio device and choose it in the settings.
settings.guardNote: On: stopping, cue, jumping and reloading an audible deck need a hold (0.4 s) or a second press.
stage.tipValue: drag: nudge while playing, scrub while stopped · wheel: zoom · Shift + wheel: look ahead
deck.phaseLong: Phase to master clock (offset in beats, ±0.5)
deck.rangeHint: click forward, right-click or wheel back
deck.overviewTipValue: audible deck only with Shift + click
guard.stop: Deck {deck} is audible – hold or press again to stop.
guard.cue: Deck {deck} is audible – cue stops it: hold or press again.
guard.load: Deck {deck} is audible – hold or press again to replace it.
guard.drop: Deck {deck} is audible – drop is locked. Hold the load key or fade the deck out first.
guard.seekShift: Deck {deck} is audible – jump only with Shift + click.
guard.seekSnap: Deck {deck} is playing – no jump without snap. F10 turns snap on.
guard.toStart: Deck {deck} is playing – jump to start is locked.
notice.missing: “{title}”: the file is no longer where it was.
notice.noneFree: No deck is empty – load deliberately with A/B or Shift + ← / →.
notice.imported: {added} tracks imported, {failed} unreadable. Analysis is running.
mixer.filterEnter: Filter in % of travel: −100 low-pass … +100 high-pass
lib.emptyText: Drag a music folder or single files onto this window. Deckwerk adds them to the library and analyses tempo, beatgrid and key in the background.
ds.cutRule: Chamfer: left half of the desk (deck A, channel A) and everything central top-left, right half (deck B, channel B) top-right. Large keys such as Play show “active” as an outline, not a fill.
ds.valueFieldNote: The value beside a control is clickable: Enter commits, Esc cancels; comma and point both work.
lib.refreshHint: scans the music folders for new files and analyses them
notice.refreshed: Library updated: {added} new, {relinked} found again, {missing} missing. Analysis is running.
notice.refreshNothing: No new files in the music folders. {missing} tracks missing.
notice.refreshNoFolder: No music folder known yet. Drag a folder onto the window.
settings.refreshNote: On: the music folders are scanned for new files at start. Music folders: {folders}. Folders you drag onto the window are added.
settings.refreshNoteEmpty: On: the music folders are scanned for new files at start. None is known yet; folders you drag onto the window are remembered.
lib.incompleteHint: The file holds less audio than it announces – probably an interrupted copy. Copy it again, then press “Update”.
notice.incomplete: “{title}” is incomplete: the file ends earlier than stated. Copy it again, then press “Update”.
lib.matchHint: for deck {deck}: {bpm} BPM ±{pct} %, key compatible with {key}
lib.matchNoRef: needs a loaded, analysed track as reference
lib.noneMatch: No track in the library matches the reference deck in tempo and key.
trans.startHint: without look-ahead: begins at the next four-bar boundary; a stopped deck enters at its position. With look-ahead: ends at the line in the centre
trans.needDecks: One deck must be playing and the other loaded. If both play, the transition goes out from the master.
trans.cancelHint: the controls stay where they are
trans.cancelled: Transition cancelled. The controls stay where they were.
trans.endHint: ends at the dashed line; the start is computed backwards. A stopped deck reaches its position exactly at the end and starts earlier accordingly
trans.tooLate: The line is too close: for this length the look-ahead must be at least {n} beats.
menu.startHint: starts at the downbeat next to this point; a stopped deck enters at its position
menu.startTooLate: This point is too close: the start needs at least {n} beats of lead.
rec.hint: records the master (after the limiter), WAV 24 bit; the file goes to the music folder under “Deckwerk”
rec.savedGaps: Recording saved ({length}), but with gaps – the disk could not keep up: {path}
ed.title: Edit transition
ed.openHint: opens the selected transition in the editor; a built-in template becomes your own copy
ed.name: Name of the transition
ed.outLong: Curve of the outgoing deck – clicks in the lane add points here
ed.inLong: Curve of the incoming deck – clicks in the lane add points here
ed.hint: Click adds a point, drag moves it (Shift: fine), double-click or Del removes it
ed.clash: Careful: in {n} place(s) two open basses run together for more than a bar (red)
ed.saveHint: saves under this name and selects the transition for the button in the stage
ed.previewHint: plays the draft on the loaded decks, from the chosen bar with one bar of lead-in. Running decks stop for this; afterwards decks and controls are back where they were
ed.previewNeedDecks: Preview needs a track on both decks.
